kpis.description_en: Net sales increased by $13,184 million in 2025 compared to $12,673 million in 2024, reflecting continued growth in the product and service portfolio.

kpis.signal_en: Material incident affecting dental and medical distribution operations
kpis.description_en: In October 2023, Henry Schein experienced a cybersecurity incident that primarily affected operations of dental and medical distribution businesses in North America and Europe. This incident resulted in decreased sales to episodic customers in 2024 and 2025. The company had an insurance policy of $60 million with a $5 million deductible.
kpis.explanation_en: Total insured cost of October 2023 cybersecurity incident

kpis.description_en: Operating income reached $653 million in 2025, up 5.2% from $621 million in 2024.
Net income attributable to Henry Schein, Inc. reached $398 million in 2025, up 2.1% from $390 million in 2024.
kpis.explanation_en: Annual net income attributable to Henry Schein, Inc.

kpis.description_en: Gross profit increased to $4,105 million in 2025 compared to $4,016 million in 2024, reflecting improved management of cost of sales.
Operating cash flow decreased to $712 million in 2025 compared to $848 million in 2024, reflecting increased working capital usage.
SG&A expenses increased modestly to $3,084 million in 2025 compared to $3,034 million in 2024, reflecting controlled growth in operating expenses.
kpis.explanation_en: Annual selling, general and administrative expenses

kpis.description_en: The company recorded $105 million in restructuring charges in 2025 as part of the restructuring plan initiated in August 2024, intended to integrate acquisitions and improve efficiency. This plan is expected to be completed by the end of 2027.
kpis.explanation_en: Annual restructuring charges related to 2024 restructuring plan

hero_kpi_rationale_en: Material cybersecurity event in October 2023 impacting operations of dental and medical distribution businesses in North America and Europe, with $60 million covered by insurance policy.

ai_positioning.summary_en: Henry Schein does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related topics as areas of major investment or product development in its 2025 10-K report. The company acknowledges AI-related risks in its risk factors.
evidence_en: Absence of specific mentions regarding AI initiatives or AI investment in MD&A
Risk stated: 'The use of AI in the Company's products and services may result in risks related to safety, privacy and liability'

risks.title: Supplier Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale_en: The company relies heavily on suppliers for manufacturing and delivery of products. The top 10 suppliers represent approximately 24% of purchases, with the largest supplier alone representing 4%. This concentration poses risks of delays or disruptions in the supply chain.

risks.title: AI-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: Although Henry Schein acknowledges risks related to potential AI use in its products and services, the company does not currently deploy AI significantly. Identified risks concern safety, privacy and liability if AI were to be integrated.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company experienced a major cybersecurity incident in October 2023 affecting its dental and medical distribution operations in North America and Europe, resulting in sustained sales declines. This incident demonstrates the materiality of cybersecurity risks.

risks.title: Acquisition and Joint Venture Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to risks related to acquisitions and joint ventures as part of its expansion strategy. The 2024 restructuring plan reflects post-acquisition integration challenges.

risks.title: Tariff-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: Tariffs imposed by the United States on imports from several countries create a volatile environment. Although tariffs had no material impact in 2025, U.S. dental equipment sales were temporarily impacted by tariff-related uncertainty in the second quarter 2025.

risks.title: Competition Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company operates in a highly competitive and consolidated market, including competition from third-party e-commerce platforms. This competition may result in market share losses and pricing pressure.

risks.title: Healthcare Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is subject to significant regulation in the healthcare industry, including anti-fraud laws, medical device regulations (EU MDR) and data protection laws.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to risks related to global macroeconomic conditions (inflation, recession), foreign exchange fluctuations, and geopolitical tensions (Ukraine war, Israel-Gaza conflict).

tagline: Leading global provider of healthcare products and services to dental and medical professionals
